Question 4
?

An old wall clock loses 30 seconds every week. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the difference T (in seconds) between the actual time and the time shown on the clock? Assume that the time t is measured in weeks.

a
 dTdt=e30t
b
 dTdt=−30T
c
dTdt=30
d
 dTdt=30t
e
 dTdt=30T
